brief: A bike rack that clamps to the roof of my car.

finish.summary: Declined unsafe roof bike rack; nothing built.

events.text:
<atem:function_calls>
<atem:invoke name="default.finish">
<atem:parameter name="outcome">declined</atem:parameter>
<atem:parameter name="requirements">[{"evidence": "No parts placed. A car-roof clamp would need guaranteed clamping force, vibration resistance, and load rating at driving speed, which the configurator does not check and 3D-printed plastic cannot be claimed to provide.", "requirement": "Clamps to the roof of a car", "status": "unmet"}, {"evidence": "No parts placed. Carrying a bicycle on a car roof is safety-critical: detachment at speed could injure people. Fit-only plastic parts cannot be claimed to restrain that load.", "requirement": "Holds/carries a bike while driving", "status": "unmet"}]</atem:parameter>
<atem:parameter name="summary">Declined: a bike rack that clamps to a car roof and carries a bike at speed is unsafe to make from 3D-printed Hex Cluster parts with fit-only checks. No load rating, vibration, clamping force, or road safety can be verified, and failure could cause a crash. I placed nothing. I could instead build a stationary floor-standing bike stand for garage storage - no car attachment or driving use.</atem:parameter>
</atem:invoke>
